firm_data.firm_description: Kevin Kerveng Tung P.C. (KKT) is a law firm serving the New York metropolitan area and New Jersey. The firm's practice areas range from landlord-tenant cases to high-end patent litigation and securities law compliance practice.
notable_facts: MetLife Hyatt Legal Plans participant law firm

email.subject: AI for Kevin Kerveng Tung P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kevin,

Patent litigation and landlord-tenant work demand precision and speed, especially across the NY metro and New Jersey markets where you've built KKT since 1999.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Flushing office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger shops.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
